recognize_zh: 中央一群十多個緊密聚集、各自帶紫色顆粒中心的小血小板，旁邊還有一片淡灰色攤開的血小板物質，這就是血小板凝集（platelet clump），會造成自動計數假性血小板低下。
features: Aggregate of approximately 15 individual platelets clustered together in the center
Each platelet shows a purple granular center (granulomere) with pale hyalomere, some with fine pseudopods
Adjacent pale grey, flattened, sheet-like structure, likely a spread/degranulated platelet or platelet material
A few single platelets scattered nearby
Background red cells with some crenated (echinocytic) forms, likely artifactual
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a central aggregate of approximately fifteen platelets, each with a purple granular center, adjacent to a pale grey flattened sheet of spread platelet material. A few single platelets are present nearby, and the background red cells include occasional crenated forms. No fibrin strands or leukocyte involvement are appreciated. Findings are consistent with platelet clumping, which can cause spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counts; review of the feathered edge and a repeat count in a citrate tube are recommended.

ddx.vs: In satellitism, platelets form a rosette around the periphery of neutrophils rather than an isolated free aggregate.
A giant platelet is a single large platelet with one continuous outline, not multiple discrete granulomeres.
Megakaryocytic cells or fragments contain nuclear material, whereas this aggregate is composed entirely of anucleate platelets.
